summary: M1 re-verified on tx (server 8, tx4c16g) after the Phase 2 changes: the branch was built into talus-local:v0.9.0-test.3, deployed through dokploy, and the Hub served that version locally and publicly with a clean startup and a completed auto-migrate. The new REQ-07 Relay modes were exercised end-to-end on the deployed build through a temporary service (standard and bounded_stream returned 200, an unknown mode was rejected with 400), and the service catalog, usage_guide detail and a real Relay request still worked against the instance that holds the dokploy-tx service.
